rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names two or more distinct values that a participant enters before a later step, and each value is described on its own: Model each named input as its own user task placed in sequence before the later step, labeling each task with exactly the input the description names. Do not add inputs, attributes or details that the description does not state, and do not fold unstated items into a task label.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a customer chooses several separately described features of a product (each named on its own) before the company passes the specifications on to other groups that build parts

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states, in one sentence, several items that the same participant enters or selects, joined by commas or 'and', and each item is a distinct input or choice the participant makes: Model each item in that list as its own user task, in the order the sentence states them, and label each task with the verb and the single item it covers, taken from the description. Do not combine two items into one task label, and do not drop any item from the list.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that one party chooses a value for each of several separately listed configurable options (a sentence lists the options, possibly ending with an open-ended allowance for more), and the chosen values are later passed on to other teams for production

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description has the customer pick one value for a component from a set of options, and the chosen value determines which one of several responsible parties builds that component, while other requested items are sent to their parties at the same time: After the step that collects the customer's selection, model an exclusive gateway with one labelled outgoing flow per option. Each flow leads to the request task for the party responsible for that option, so only the party for the chosen option receives a request. Keep a parallel split for the items that have no alternatives. Join the option branches with an exclusive merge before the parallel join that waits for all parts. Do not connect the parallel split to every option's request task.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description has the customer pick one value for a component from a set of options, and the chosen value determines which one of several responsible parties builds that component, while other requested items are sent to their parties at the same time

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that one set of information is sent to several different parties, each of which produces a separate part that is needed later: Model one send activity per receiving party, each placed after the step that prepares the information and each leading to its own part-producing activity. Do not merge these sends into a single send activity. Join the parallel branches with a parallel gateway before the step that needs all the parts, because all branches must complete.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that one set of information is sent to several different parties, each of which produces a separate part that is needed later

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says an outside customer makes several separate choices about the product (for example, options, quantities, or colours) before the producer starts production, and each choice is described as its own decision: Model each separate customer choice as its own user task in the customer's lane, placed in parallel after the receive element that collects the customer's request and before a parallel gateway that joins them. Send the available options to the customer with a send task before the receive, and do not collapse the separate choices into one task or leave them implicit. Only after the join should the producer send the chosen items onward to production.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says an outside customer makes several separate choices about the product (for example, options, quantities, or colours) before the producer starts production, and each choice is described as its own decision

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that during an ongoing activity the process produces a document or report, and that this document is then sent to other parties: Model the production of the document as its own manual or user task placed on the sequence flow after the activity during which it is produced and before the send task that delivers it. Do not fold the production into the surrounding activity or into the send task, and keep the send task as a separate step.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that during an ongoing activity the process produces a document or report, and that this document is then sent to other parties
